components.css: .artifact-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; border: 1px solid var(--hairline-strong); background: var(--background-color); transition: border-color 140ms ease-out; } .artifact-card:hover { border-color: var(--primary-color); } .card-artwork { display: block; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; overflow: hidden; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--hairline); } .card-artwork img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .card-title a { color: var(--font-color); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; } .card-title a:hover { color: var(--primary-color); background: transparent; } .card-summary { color: var(--secondary-color); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.5; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 3; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .card-actions { margin-top: auto; padding-top: 0.75rem; } .artifact-card.artifact-book { flex-direction: row; } .artifact-card.artifact-book .card-artwork { width: 38%; aspect-ratio: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--code-bg-color, #e8eff2); } .artifact-card.artifact-book .card-artwork img { width: auto; height: auto; max-width: 100%; max-height: 100%; object-fit: contain; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); } .command-plate { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; width: 100%; height: 100%; padding: 1.25rem; background: var(--code-bg-color, #e8eff2); } .command-line { font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--font-color); overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .command-prompt { color: var(--secondary-color); margin-right: 0.4em; } .command-caret { display: inline-block; width: 0.55em; height: 1.05em; margin-left: 0.3em; vertical-align: -0.18em; background: var(--primary-color); } .artifact-card:hover .command-caret { animation: cursor-blink 1.1s steps(1) infinite; }

components.name: Action Row
components.description: Prompt-style lowercase links separated by middots; hovers underline, never paint a block.
components.css: .front-actions { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .front-actions li { display: flex; align-items: center; padding-left: 0; } .front-actions li::before, .front-actions li::after { content: none; } .front-actions li:not(:last-child)::after { content: "·"; position: static; top: auto; left: auto; margin: 0 0.6em; color: var(--secondary-color); } .front-actions a { color: var(--primary-color); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; } .front-actions a:hover { text-decoration: underline; background: transparent; }

narrative.overview: A terminal that publishes. The collection pages read as a wall of equals: every artifact is one identical card in a uniform responsive grid. Real artwork is linked at the source, never duplicated, never fabricated.
keyCharacteristics: One accent per theme; titles stay ink in both modes
Equal emphasis: identical cards, actions on a shared baseline
Real artifacts are the only large imagery
Link hovers shift color, never paint a background block
Artwork-less artifacts show their real command as a terminal prompt, not a placeholder

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The accent blue appears only on interactive elements; titles are ink in both themes.

rules.name: The Prompt Case Rule
rules.body: Action links are lowercase shell-command style, separated by middot pseudo-elements positioned static.

rules.name: The Physical Object Rule
rules.body: A shadow is reserved for depicted physical objects; UI chrome never casts one.

rules.name: The Equal Wall Rule
rules.body: Every artifact gets one identical card; nothing is featured, nothing is a footnote.

dos: Do hotlink artwork from its source (ytimg CDN, Leanpub CDN)
Do strip terminal.css list markers and 20px li padding inside restyled lists
Do keep card heights equal per row (flex column + margin-top: auto)
donts: Don't copy artwork files into the repo
Don't feature one artifact above the others
Don't let link hovers paint a background block
Don't fabricate imagery for artifacts that lack it
